_comment: Audit results (2026-10-15, upstream commit 1a8c4fd). Keys are PP/NN = phase number / lesson number. level: ok = claims checked and correct; wrong = verified error; stale = outdated; weak = flawed demo or thin; unverified = anecdote. Lessons not listed were NOT audited.

01/09: Formulas right; GPT-2 perplexity quoted as both ~30 and 50; MI-bias caveat missing
01/15: Advises Wilcoxon on 5 CV folds (min p=0.0625, can never reach 0.05); no code in Build It
03/07: Doc backward pass omits dropout mask; demo cannot overfit; 'conclusion' is hard-coded; GPT-3 tokens wrong
03/12: JIT benchmark lacks block_until_ready (bogus speedup); optax and PaLM claims wrong or unsourced
05/10: Best sampled lesson; worked example verified by hand; cites lesson 09 numbers that don't exist
05/21: False claim that RAGAS/RAG evals use NLI; sample outputs invented
07/08: Stub Build It, no cross-attention code, no quiz
07/16: Speculative-decoding math correct; hardware (70B on one H100) and 'default everywhere' claims wrong
10/02: Several factual errors; without the regex package, non-ASCII text is silently dropped
10/11: Benchmark table fabricated; KV-cache and memory math wrong; simulated AWQ is a no-op
11/05: Context windows wrong or outdated (Opus 4.7 1M, Gemini 3 Pro 1M)
11/08: LoRA target-module advice contradicts QLoRA paper; 'NF4' is uniform int4; memory math wrong
11/09: Treats Opus 4.6 and GPT-5 as the frontier/judge models
11/10: Treats Opus 4.6 and GPT-5 as the frontier models
11/11: Prices wrong: Opus 4.7 is $5/$25, GPT-5 $1.25/$10, Gemini 3 Pro about $2/$12
11/15: Cache minimums and OpenAI 50% discount outdated (GPT-5 cached is 90% off)
11/17: Mixes AutoGen 0.2/0.4 APIs; AutoGen now in maintenance mode; dangling cross-refs; empty quiz explanations
13/01: Says parallel tool use is opt-in on Anthropic; it is the default
13/02: Says Anthropic has no strict-mode flag; strict: true exists
13/06: MCP stateless details matched official spec and changelog
13/09: Error codes and per-request _meta matched spec
13/20: Calls OTel GenAI semantic conventions stable; they are still in Development
14/01: ReAct citation correct; lists AutoGen v0.4 as a current harness
14/03: Reflexion '130% improvement' is wrong: paper reports +22% absolute
14/04: ToT and LATS citations and headline numbers verified
14/06: Toolformer and BFCL V4 weights verified
14/09: Mem0 2026 docs numbers attributed to the 2025 paper
14/10: Voyager citation and headline numbers verified
14/17: No real Claude Agent SDK code; toy harness has no LLM; 'parallel' subagents run sequentially
14/28: Every 'pattern' reuses one keyword classifier; printed conclusions are hard-coded
14/32: ICLR 2026 AMBIG-SWE numbers not found in the paper
14/38: arXiv 2604.01483 is real but a narrow finance-compliance fit
14/39: Cloudflare figures only via secondary coverage; other stats anecdotal
15/01: METR doubling time outdated (about 4 months per TH1.1, not 7); Opus 4.6 two generations behind
15/05: AI Scientist-v2 and Beel et al. verified
15/07: RSP v3.0 correct; workshop dates imprecise
15/08: DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework v3 outdated (v3.1 published April 2026)
16/04: Three orchestrators produce identical output; no quiz; 'four primitives' oversimplified
16/11: Accurate on Swarm and Agents SDK handoffs; router is keyword-based; no quiz
17/01: Model examples outdated (Claude 3.7, Gemini 2.5, GPT-5 as current)
17/04: vLLM v0.18.0 feature matrix is old
17/07: '7x' H100 vs GB200 comparison misreads SemiAnalysis (the $0.012 is GB200 vs MI325X)
18/04: Real arXiv cites, but Science DOI looks fabricated and the toy simulator contradicts the claim
18/22: Misattributed paper; epsilon proxy never reaches the claimed range; no canary code despite the doc
13/24: Skill catalog entry of about 100 tokens matches the Agent Skills spec

phase_trust.01: 2 lessons sampled: one sound, one with a statistical-advice error.
phase_trust.03: 2 lessons sampled, both flawed (buggy doc code, bogus benchmark).
phase_trust.05: 2 lessons sampled: attention lesson strong, NLI lesson has false claims.
phase_trust.07: 2 lessons sampled: speculative-decoding math right, T5/BART is a stub.
phase_trust.10: 2 lessons sampled, both with serious errors (tokenizer, fabricated quantization numbers).
phase_trust.11: Whole phase fact-checked: pricing, model and context-window numbers mostly wrong or stale; LoRA advice contradicts its source paper.
phase_trust.13: Claims swept in lessons 01-12 and 20-27; only lessons with an ok/WRONG/stale flag had specific claims verified. MCP lessons 06-12 and 23 matched the spec; lessons 13-19 and 28-45 were not audited. API comparisons (01-03) and OTel (20) have errors.
phase_trust.14: Claims swept in lessons 01-10 and 30-40: paper citations reliable; 17 and 28 (sampled separately) are thin toys; 31-40 lean on unverifiable blog anecdotes. Lessons 11-29 mostly not audited.
phase_trust.15: Lessons 01-08 fact-checked: mostly correct, some outdated vendor and benchmark status.
phase_trust.16: 2 lessons sampled: thin, heavy overlap with 14/28 and 11/17.
phase_trust.17: Lessons 01-10 fact-checked: weakest phase factually (wrong parameter count, misread benchmark, stale versions).
phase_trust.18: 2 lessons sampled: real citations but toy code that does not support the text; one misattribution.
phase_trust.19: Not audited. Capstone projects; see repo-guide.md.
